images.caption: The Captain George Flavel House Museum, located at 441 8th Street in Astoria, Oregon, United States. It is listed on the US National Register of Historic Places (NRHP). The NRHP listing comprises two houses, the main house and the carriage house, both built circa 1885. This image shows the main house, with its corner observatory tower.
images.alt: The Captain George Flavel House Museum, located at 441 8th Street in Astoria, Oregon, United States. It is listed on the US National Register of Historic Places (NRHP). The NRHP listing comprises two houses, the main house and the carriage house, both built circa 1885. This image shows the main house, with its corner observatory tower.

images.caption: Flavel House Museum in Astoria, Oregon in December 2011. This building is one of four different Flavel Houses in Astoria that are all listed on the National Register of Historic Places.  Two share a single listing, as the "Captain George Flavel House and Carriage House", both built in 1884–85. This photo shows one of those two buildings, the main house (as opposed to the carriage house).

images.caption: Flavel House Museum in Astoria, Oregon in December 2011. This building is one of four different Flavel Houses in Astoria that are all listed on the National Register of Historic Places.  Two share a single listing, as the "Captain George Flavel House and Carriage House", both built in 1884–85. This photo shows one of those two buildings, the main house (as opposed to the carriage house), focusing on the north facade.  The building has a rounded observatory tower on its northeast corner.
